_comment: Screenshot / Live Stream module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_note_binary: Image data is sent as TWO consecutive WebSocket messages: first a JSON 'frame_meta', then one BINARY message (raw JPEG bytes as ArrayBuffer). The receiver must pair them in order.

screenshot_once._desc: Request a single screenshot from one or more agents

stream_start._desc: Start a continuous screen stream at the given FPS

frame_meta._desc: Sent immediately BEFORE the binary JPEG frame. The next WebSocket message is the raw JPEG bytes.

binary_frame._desc: Raw JPEG bytes (ArrayBuffer). Always follows a frame_meta with matching seq. Not JSON — shown here only for documentation.
